extension.description: A coding agent for LLM services without native tool calling.
viewContainer.title: broke-code
view.chat.name: Chat
command.setApiKey.title: Set API key
config.providers.description: LLM services that speak the OpenAI chat API. Each entry has a unique `name` and a `baseUrl`, the API root such as `http://localhost:11434/v1`. API keys are stored in the editor's secret storage, never here. Read from user settings only: a workspace cannot override this list, so a repository cannot redirect a stored key.
config.providers.name.description: Unique name shown in the chat panel.
config.providers.baseUrl.description: API root, for example `http://localhost:11434/v1`. broke-code appends `/models` and `/chat/completions`.
